QuestInfo.name: Vanished Vita
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Claudine in Secret Plaza, Edelstein.
QuestInfo.1: Vita recently started acting strangely, then vanished. Claudine wants you to find her. Vita was last seen going towards the mine.
QuestInfo.2: Claudine sent you after Vita, who vanished after acting weird.  She was seen going towards the mine, and though you quickly went after her, you couldn't save her.

0.0: #b#h0##k! Thank goodness you're here! We have to find Vita, quickly!\r\n#L0##bWhat's going on?#l\n#k
0.1: About an hour ago, Vita came to Wendelline about a headache she was having, when she started saying weird things and telling everyone to stay away. Then she ran out... We can't let the Black Wings see her! Please, find her quickly!\r\n#L0##bWhich way did she go?#l\n#k
0.2: I'm not sure. Before she ran out, she said something like: #b'Stay away! It's going to go off! I have to return to the laboratory!'#k ...or something like that. Please, help us find her.

yes.0: If she's trying to go back to the laboratory, she'll be headed towards the mine.

1.0: #b#h0##k! Stay away! Don't come any closer!\r\n#L0##bVita! What happened? What's going on?#l\n#k
1.1: I-I'm lucky to have a friend like you... Please, don't forget me when I'm gone...\r\n#L0##bWhat are you talking about? Come with me, it's too dangerous for you out here!#l\n#k
1.2: No. I can't return. Please, listen to me. Gelimer, he implanted a bomb in me. I think he realized that I was being protected by the Resistance, because...because he's turned it on. If I go back to town, many people will be eliminated. I'm going to go into the mine. That way, everyone else will be safe...\r\n#L0##bVita, no! There's got to be another way! Come back with me to the Secret Plaza, and we'll figure something out!#l\n#k
